info.title: Suedhang Speakr-owned web parity API
info.description: Proposed own-platform extension. Not an existing Speakr or inesKIS API; implementation/contract tests required.

get.description: Existing correction resource; document, document_version and recognition_marks are additive planned fields. Their absence preserves the legacy plain-text snapshot. Requires current correction_read permission.

200.description: Revision-bound correction snapshot. Recognition marks are server-derived evidence, not user-authored audio markers or fabricated confidence.

post.description: Existing atomic correction save; rich document and move_map support is planned. Requires correction_edit permission and the current edit lease. Legacy requests may omit all rich fields. With document, expected_document_version is required and compares the snapshot on expected_text_revision_id (0 means none). An exact replay returns its original result; changed content with a stale version fails without writes. Text must equal the normalized document projection. Missing document must not erase a stored rich snapshot silently.

200.description: Text, document, transformed anchors and correction position committed atomically; document_version, when returned, belongs to the new text_revision_id.

400.description: Invalid payload, document projection, move map or mark data; no writes

409.description: REVISION_CONFLICT: stale If-Match, expected_text_revision_id, expected_state_version or expected_document_version; LEASE_STALE: stale lease_generation; IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: changed retry body. No writes; reload and reconcile, never overwrite blindly.

post.summary: Execute one typed, authorized web parity command

200.description: Committed/queued result; never proof of external delivery

CorrectionDocument.description: CanonicalDocument v1 from src.clinic.richtext. Stable node/run IDs are globally unique within the document. At most 8192 runs and 1000000 projected code points overall. No raw markup, surrogate code points, links or active content. Paragraphs project with newline separators; normalized projection equals text. New or rewritten text has no invented audio anchor; unchanged moved/formatted runs retain validated provenance.

CorrectionMove.description: One unchanged stable run moved from expected_text_revision_id to the submitted document. Half-open Unicode code-point offsets in raw document projections, never UTF-16 units. Each range must be nonempty, in bounds, equal in length and text, and match segment_id in both documents. Entries must have unique segment IDs and nonoverlapping old/new spans. Validate against stored provenance; never manufacture an audio anchor from client offsets.

CorrectionRecognitionMark.description: Read-only local recognition evidence for the exact snapshot text/audio revisions. Half-open Unicode code-point range in snapshot text, nonempty and in bounds. low_confidence means the recognizer reported uncertainty; unrecognized means it explicitly reported a recognition gap. Missing/null confidence means unavailable, never zero or an inferred score. Marks become stale when either revision changes and must not be reused as current evidence.

audio_synced.description: For an imported text revision, whether the current audio is the one imported with that text.

document_version.description: Snapshot version scoped to text_revision_id; 0 means no persisted rich snapshot, positive values identify immutable snapshots.

x-semantic-guards: expected_revision=0 only for object creation; existing aggregates require current version
insert/overwrite require a source segment; trim forbids it
routing person requires one user; staff_pool requires pool; self requires matching author
request/source IDs scoped to principal and permitted agent; machine auth cannot call this user command endpoint
save_filter enforces max 20 per user; report end greater than start with bounded period
acceptance/release/export verify matching audio/text/context revisions and clinical policy
rendered file != local saved file != delivered KIS document
all original BT remain normative even when no allowed web action exists
